description: This file defines an Android activity 'CompassActivity' that utilizes device sensors (accelerometer and magnetic field) to render a real-time 3D compass using OpenGL ES. It implements sensor event handling, sensor management, and OpenGL rendering routines, including setup and drawing of a basic 3D model representing the compass. The class manages sensor registration/unregistration during lifecycle events and performs matrix transformations for rendering the compass orientation based on sensor data.

classes.name: CompassActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a 3D compass using OpenGL ES. It handles sensor registration, sensor events, and rendering graphs the device's orientation in real-time.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes sensor manager, creates GLSurfaceView, and sets the renderer.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers sensor listeners for accelerometer and magnetic field sensors.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listeners and pauses OpenGL view.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Clears buffers, applies rotation matrix, and draws the 3D compass model.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the viewport and projection matrix upon surface size change.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initial OpenGL setup and creation/loading of 3D model buffers.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Updates sensor data, computes rotation matrix and orientation, logs orientation periodically.

methods.name: onAccuracyChanged
methods.description: Placeholder for handling sensor accuracy changes.
